visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outdoor street scene. A person in a green puffer jacket wearing a traditional opera mask holds two ice cream cones in front of a white Mister Softee truck. Digital money icons float across the screen. (2) Indoor restaurant. A woman in a beige blazer feeds a young boy in a blue shirt a spoonful of a dark, jelly-like dessert. She pours a bottle of honey/syrup over the bowl. (3) Close-up of a white paper cup filled with milk tea, followed by the woman walking in a narrow Hong Kong alleyway lined with graffiti and air conditioning units. She holds the cup and a black can. (4) The woman and the boy are dancing synchronously in the alleyway, performing a repetitive hand-and-leg routine. (5) A stage performance is shown with dancers in white costumes holding baskets. The scene then cuts to a close-up of the boy dancing energetically against a glowing LED background. (6) A concert hall scene viewed through a circular mask shows an orchestra and a conductor. The final scene shows the woman in a white dress, crying and wiping her eyes in a backstage area while holding a gift box.

(2) The music continues as a consistent bed. The female voice speaks with high pitch and excitement, describing food. The sound of liquid pouring into a bowl is subtly audible. (3) A transitions to outdoor street ambience with low-frequency urban hum. The music shifts to a more rhythmic, dance-oriented beat. A synthesized 'whoosh' effect accompanies a quick camera movement.
